svg.title: Topological ordering
svg.desc: A topological order lists every event so that each edge points forward. Many such orders usually exist; a cycle makes it impossible.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
